e.title: ReIns
e.summary: 再保险精算与统计函数（CRAN 1.0.16）：Albrecher/Beirlant/Teugels 经典教材《Reinsurance》配套包
e.summary_en: Reinsurance actuarial/statistical functions (CRAN 1.0.16): companion to Albrecher/Beirlant/Teugels classic textbook 'Reinsurance'
e.summary_hk: 再保險精算與統計函數（CRAN 1.0.16）：Albrecher/Beirlant/Teugels 經典教材《Reinsurance》配套包
e.body: ReIns（CRAN 1.0.16）提供《Reinsurance: Actuarial and Statistical Aspects》（Albrecher、Beirlant、Teugels，2017，Wiley）教材的配套函数：再保险精算与统计方法——损失分布、极值方法、再保险定价的经典技术。对 RIAA：再保险方向的权威教材配套——[[reinsurance]]（概念）的统计实现层；极值理论（[[insurance-evt]]、[[extremrisks]]）在再保险中的应用；与 [[aggregate-python]]（聚合分布）、[[insurance-ilf]]（ILF 定价）配套；三位作者（Albrecher 等）是再保险精算的权威；适合再保险方向深入学习。
e.body_en: ReIns (CRAN 1.0.16) provides functions from the textbook 'Reinsurance: Actuarial and Statistical Aspects' (Albrecher, Beirlant, Teugels, 2017, Wiley): reinsurance actuarial and statistical methods — loss distributions, extreme value methods, classical reinsurance pricing techniques. For RIAA: the authoritative textbook companion for reinsurance — the statistical implementation layer of [[reinsurance]] (concepts); extreme value theory ([[insurance-evt]], [[extremrisks]]) applied to reinsurance; pairs with [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate distributions) and [[insurance-ilf]] (ILF pricing); the three authors (Albrecher et al.) are authorities in reinsurance actuarial science; suits in-depth reinsurance study.
e.body_hk: ReIns（CRAN 1.0.16）提供《Reinsurance: Actuarial and Statistical Aspects》（Albrecher、Beirlant、Teugels，2017，Wiley）教材的配套函數：再保險精算與統計方法——損失分佈、極值方法、再保險定價的經典技術。對 RIAA：再保險方向的權威教材配套——[[reinsurance]]（概念）的統計實現層；極值理論（[[insurance-evt]]、[[extremrisks]]）在再保險中的應用；與 [[aggregate-python]]（聚合分佈）、[[insurance-ilf]]（ILF 定價）配套；三位作者（Albrecher 等）是再保險精算的權威；適合再保險方向深入學習。
